hero: Get help with your computer from someone you trust
step1: Download and open DeskShare on your computer.
step2: Choose “I need help”. Tell someone you trust your number and code.
step3: Your helper enters them in the browser or app and sees your screen.
permission: The helper can ask to control your mouse and keyboard. You decide for every connection; without an answer the request is denied after 30 seconds. You can stop sharing at any time.
validity: The code changes every 60 seconds. If it changes, read the new code.
tech_body: WebRTC provides low-latency screen sharing with end-to-end encrypted media (DTLS/SRTP), directly or through a TURN relay. DeskShare is free and open source.
home.need_hint: Show your screen to someone you trust.
home.give_hint: Enter the other person’s number and code.
language.label: Language
safety.title: Unexpected call? Do not share.
safety.body: Hang up and call a person or company you trust using a verified number. Do not show banking screens or share passwords.
